relations.myth: Yaldabaoth generates subordinate authorities and powers
relations.note: The chief ruler generates the subordinate archons who administer the lower cosmos.

relations.myth: Sophia produces Ialdabaoth, progenitor of the rulers
relations.note: The rulers descend through Ialdabaoth from Sophia’s unauthorized act of generation.

relations.myth: Pistis Sophia generates or expels the arrogant ruler
relations.note: Some cosmogonies make the archontic order descend from the ruler produced or expelled by Pistis Sophia.

relations.myth: Providence recovers stolen light from the lower creation
relations.note: The higher providential power intervenes against Yaldabaoth’s archontic creation to recover divine light.

relations.myth: Sabaoth condemns his father and leaves the archontic faction
relations.note: Yaldabaoth envies and opposes the repentant Sabaoth after he condemns his father.

relations.myth: The rulers construct Adam from cosmic substances
relations.note: They model Adam’s body on a reflected heavenly image but cannot initially make him stand.

relations.myth: Heavenly powers trick Yaldabaoth into animating Adam
relations.note: Yaldabaoth is tricked into breathing his stolen divine light into Adam.

relations.myth: The rulers pursue and assault the spiritual Woman
relations.note: They pursue Eve and sexually assault her apparent or earthly form after her spiritual power escapes.

relations.myth: The rulers attempt to seize Norea
relations.note: They try to dominate Norea, who rejects their claimed paternity and invokes help from above.

relations.myth: The chief ruler orders Noah to build the ark
relations.note: The chief archon instructs Noah to construct an ark before the flood.

relations.myth: Norea burns the ark and confronts the rulers
relations.note: After burning Noah’s first ark, Norea later confronts the rulers who seek to control her.
Sophia’s announcements of the higher Christ alarm the rulers.

relations.myth: Ialdabaoth unknowingly prepares conditions for Jesus
relations.note: Ialdabaoth unknowingly helps prepare the circumstances for Jesus within the lower creation.

relations.myth: Jesus reveals mysteries for passing archontic realms
relations.note: Jesus supplies initiates with seals, names, and mysteries enabling passage through the rulers’ guarded domains.

relations.myth: Pistis Sophia passes through lower cosmic punishments
relations.note: Planetary archons participate in the cosmic machinery and punishments through which Pistis Sophia passes.

relations.myth: Darkness defeats Primal Man and engulfs his sons
relations.note: Manichaean archons defeat Primal Man’s forces and trap their luminous substance in matter.

relations.myth: The luminous manifestation excites the archons
relations.note: Her beautiful manifestation arouses the archons, causing them to emit swallowed particles of light.

relations.myth: The Messenger’s forms excite the archons
relations.note: The Messenger displays attractive male and female forms, inducing the archons to release consumed light.
